opening.argument: The description ties access to coin-related information directly to payment: viewers are told to join the academy by buying the course or paying “EUR 19.95 per month” to receive the coin-related offering. This is not merely general education. The paid access includes recurring presentations of an “exciting coin” said to have “the potential in the next Bullrun,” followed by an invitation to “build your portfolio with it.” Those claims connect payment to speculative token information and portfolio-building activity, while leaving the PancakeSwap-Google discussion as contextual commentary rather than the mechanism through which viewers are asked to pay.

citations.quote: Then join my academy by either buying the crypto course (see link above) or completing a subscription at EUR 19.95 per month (can be canceled at any time) in order to only receive the coin.
Every 1st and every 3. Tuesday of the month I present an exciting coin that has the potential in the next Bullrun.
Would you like to get to know this coin and build your portfolio with it?
PancakeSwap and Google are working together.
